conclusion.summary: All 4, 12, and 24 epoch replicates matched iteration004 on every permitted metric.

metric_definitions.mean_turns: mean final turn from checked run_local_battle summary rows
metric_definitions.overall_win_rate: wins / all scheduled games; draws remain in the denominator
metric_definitions.paired_delta: mean(candidate_win - iteration004_win) on identical (opponent, seat, seed) keys
metric_definitions.seat_win_rate: wins / games grouped by policy seat
metric_definitions.severe_abnormal_action: deployment-audit decision where protected=true and action differs from teacher_action
metric_definitions.severe_abnormal_action_rate: severe abnormal actions / all deployment-audit decisions
